subject: general
question:
Which part of the given sentence has an error ?

__Little effort __(A)\ __has been done __(B)\ __to solve __(C)\ __the problem__.(D)
solution:
The correct answer is **has been done.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In the given statement the **error is in part B **of the sentence **as efforts are made and not done.**
 
• In part b, **done** should be replaced by **made.**

Thus, the correct sentence will be: **Little effort has been made to solve the problem.**
